name: list of songs recorded by Zubeen Garg

rules.history: One snapshot a day per board: written after each reading refresh and platform-charts refresh, plus every Google scan (free or paid, per its mode) and free Google RSS sweep. Kept 400 days. Weekly rank = the best rank that week (Mon–Sun). Weeks on board = weeks with any rank.
rules.seed: Weeks before history started were rebuilt from stored 60-day curves: a seeded rank is the rank among the titles that had a curve then — not the full board. Seeded points are marked.
rules.netflix: Netflix's official India Top 10 (weekly, Mon–Sun; imported TSV): weeks this title spent in it. Never used to rank.
rules.charts: Top Charts · Google scan (free or paid, per its mode): rank by heat among the scan's lead rows in its lane (Google, no reads).
rules.rss: Top Charts · free Google Trending-now RSS sweep: rank by heat among the sweep's lead rows.
rules.reading: What India is reading: rank by Indian-language Wikipedia reads (7 days) WITHIN the lane (Entertainment or Sport — the page's default 'Both' view ranks the two together, so its numbers differ); per edition by that edition's reads. Reads, never viewers.
rules.platform: Platform Charts · Latest: rank within the platform by 7-day Wikipedia reads (most-read, never 'most watched').
